name: Teen Camp
description_short: A weekly summer program for teens ages 13–15 run by the Boys & Girls Club of Greenwich. It includes field trips and local travel, service learning, leadership training, and activities such as cooking classes and yoga.

sources.note: Drafted by the listing tool from this page

warnings: The page only shows the 2026 season (June 22 – August 14, 2026), which is already over as of 2026-10-13. Dates for 2027 have not been posted.
The camp is offered week by week, but the page does not list the individual weeks. It is recorded as one season-long block.
The address and phone number are the Club's main contact details from the page footer. The page does not say exactly where Teen Camp meets.
The page says the program is 'designed for high school students' but lists ages 13–15, which includes some middle-school ages.
The page does not directly say campers go home each night. 'Day' is inferred from the field-trip and downtown-walk format.
